terms.gloss: build a wall round, fortify; protect, secure
evidence: Cic. Prov. Cons. 34: Alpibus Ītaliam mūnierat ante nātūra (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 2.5: castra vallō fossāque mūnīre (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 1.49: mīlitēs mūnītiōne prohibēre (Lewis & Short)
Sall. Jug. 38.6: per mūnītiōnem introīre (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: a rampart set with stakes, a palisaded earthwork
evidence: Caes. BG 2.5: castra vallō fossāque mūnīre (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Att. 9.12.3: aliquem vallō et fossā saeptum tenēre (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: nature had already fortified Italy with the Alps

phrases.latin: crēscēbat interim urbs mūnītiōnibus alia atque alia appetendō loca
phrases.english: meanwhile the city was growing, taking in one place after another with its defences
to fortify a camp with a rampart and a ditch
